cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(SpectrePackageConsumer LANGUAGES CXX)
option(SPECTRE_CONSUME_WIDGETS "Also verify the optional installed Qt target" OFF)
find_package(VltSpectre CONFIG REQUIRED COMPONENTS Core)
add_executable(consumer main.cpp)
target_link_libraries(consumer PRIVATE VltSpectre::Core)
if(SPECTRE_CONSUME_WIDGETS)
    find_package(VltSpectre CONFIG REQUIRED COMPONENTS Widgets)
    target_link_libraries(consumer PRIVATE VltSpectre::Widgets)
    target_compile_definitions(consumer PRIVATE SPECTRE_CONSUME_WIDGETS)
endif()
enable_testing()
add_test(NAME installed_consumer COMMAND consumer)
set_tests_properties(installed_consumer PROPERTIES ENVIRONMENT "QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen")
